title: Policy-led deployment guardrails with playbook-driven approvals
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and implement a policy-driven approval and change-management layer for model rollouts (canary/A-B/shadow) that ties RBAC, timeboxed signoffs, evidence bundles, and audit logs into a single playbook UI and API. Goal: make safe production rollouts the default for enterprise customers, support delegated approvals, and enable automated rollback when quality or latency SLOs breach policy thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Console UI: create/edit deployment playbooks that enumerate required sign-offs, approver roles, escalation windows, and acceptable SLO thresholds
API: playbooks accessible via REST/SDK; rollout orchestration engine enforces sign-off gates before percent increase beyond canary stage
RBAC: roles map to SSO groups (approver, reviewer, operator); delegated approvals expire after a configurable window
Audit: every sign-off stores an immutable evidence bundle (PR link, diff, evaluation snapshot, approver comment) with tamper-evident metadata and 365-day retention
Auto-rollback: when live metrics (latency, error-rate, qualitative eval score) cross playbook thresholds for configured evaluation windows, the system initiates rollback and records reason
Non-blocking mode: support advisory sign-offs (warnings) that do not block rollouts but are recorded and visible in timeline
comments: 2026-02-18 - Aisha Kapoor: Initial draft of requirements after scoping workshop with SRE and Security. Key ask from sales: delegated approvals for regulated customers and ability to attach third-party evaluation reports.

2026-02-22 - Marco Chen: Met with Design to review wireframes. Decision: single-playbook resource per deployment pipeline with optional environment overrides (staging vs prod). UX should minimize friction for PLG users while exposing enterprise controls behind a 'Governance' toggle.

2026-02-25 - Lina Ortiz (SRE): Proposed auto-rollback triggers: 3x baseline error-rate sustained for 5 minutes, 2x p95 latency above baseline for 10 minutes, or model-eval score delta > 5% on a canonical prompt set. Suggested adding an immediate 'pause' action before full rollback.

2026-02-27 - Samir Patel (Security): Audit log schema needs to include signer SSO ID, request headers, linked PR/commit SHA, snapshot of evaluation artifacts (hash + storage pointer), and KMS-wrapped evidence metadata. Retention policy: 1 year for standard, 7 years for regulated customers (configurable).

2026-02-28 - Marco Chen: Updated acceptance criteria to include 'advisory sign-offs' for trials where customers want visibility without blocking. Also added API requirement for programmatic approvals from CI (e.g., GH Actions bot with scoped service account).

2026-03-02 - Aisha Kapoor: Added due_date and flagged security_review_required=true. Next steps: align with ENG-44120 owners to define gate contract and schedule spike for immutable evidence bundle storage.
decisions: Adopt a playbook-first model: single source of truth for required approvals + rollback thresholds to reduce config sprawl
Support both blocking and advisory sign-offs to cover enterprise and PLG workflows
Evidence bundles will live in the audit-log-store as content-addressed artifacts with metadata pointing to source (PR, eval run ID).
Auto-rollback will be gated behind a configurable cooldown and a pause step; immediate rollback only if operator-configured 'force' flag is set.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Approval friction could slow PLG adoption. Mitigation: default playbook for new orgs uses advisory mode and lightweight approver roles; enterprise templates opt-in to blocking flows.
Risk: Large evidence bundles increase storage/cost. Mitigation: store hashes + compressed artifacts and allow orgs to configure retention tiering.
Risk: Malicious approver impersonation. Mitigation: require SSO + 2FA for approvers and record request provenance including IP and user-agent in audit entry.
implementation_notes: Backend: extend rollout-orchestration to evaluate playbook gates at each stage transition. Gate API returns allowed_actions + required_approvals metadata.
Console: playbook editor with staged preview and ability to simulate rollouts; timeline UI to view sign-offs and evidence bundles.
API: approvals endpoint allowing approver identity, comment, evidence links, and an optional attest signature (OIDC JWT) for programmatic flows.
SRE: expose canonical metrics (error-rate, p95 latency, eval_score) via runtime metrics exporter; provide a webhook sink for external monitoring tools to push signals.
next_steps: Schedule 2-week implementation spike with ENG-44120 owners to prototype Gate API contract (week of 2026-03-08)
Design to produce high-fidelity playbook editor screens and timeline interactions by 2026-03-15
Security to draft audit schema and retention toggle options by 2026-03-20
Sales/Customer Success to validate enterprise templates with 3 pilot customers (target kickoff 2026-03-30)
